mode.note: Preserves the pre-release hint behavior. The exact visual scaffold is not chess-validated.

includeMotifNames.note: Naming the motif is a scaffolded retrieval aid; the exact chess transfer is untested.

copy.value: We highlighted the starting square of the correct piece.
copy.note: Task-level hint copy retained from the historic solving surface.

lossesInRowCount.note: Default consecutive-loss count for the tilt safeguard; the exact chess threshold is unvalidated.

lossesInTimeWindowMs.note: Default time window for the tilt safeguard; the exact chess threshold is unvalidated.

performanceDeclineThreshold.note: Default win-rate decline threshold for the tilt safeguard; the exact chess threshold is unvalidated.

performanceRecentWindowGames.note: Recent-game window for the tilt safeguard; retained from the pre-release heuristic.

performanceBaselineWindowGames.note: Baseline-game window for the tilt safeguard; retained from the pre-release heuristic.

performanceMinimumSampleGames.note: Minimum games in each tilt window; retained from the pre-release heuristic.

entropyWindowCp.note: Evaluation window for the high-entropy heuristic; no standard chess implementation exists.

fallbackRplThresholdCp.note: Defensive fallback when a band record is unavailable; valid releases provide every band record.

winMoveCpLossThreshold.note: Existing heuristic for finding imperfect wins; not a validated training threshold.

winConversionBonus.note: Existing heuristic bonus for a winning conversion opportunity; not a validated training threshold.

lossMoveCpLossThreshold.note: Existing heuristic for finding errors in losses; the diagnostic threshold is not a training claim.

drawMoveCpLossThreshold.note: Existing heuristic for finding errors in draws; not a validated training threshold.

drawFailedConversionBonus.note: Existing heuristic bonus for a failed conversion in a draw; not a validated training threshold.

maxSuggestions.note: Display cap for suggested analysis games; retained from the pre-release surface.
